name: eka-monorepo
description: Root task runner for the Engineering Knowledge Advisor monorepo (apps/api, apps/web).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web ci && uv sync --project apps/api
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.infra.yaml up -d --wait db minio
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn main:app --app-dir apps/api/src --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:stop: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.infra.yaml stop db minio
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build --wait && echo Application available at http://localhost:8080, [npm run docker:down] to stop the containers
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
